categories.name: Story Mode
categories.rules:
**Story Mode Rules**

- Complete this level in Story Mode  
- All Extras must be turned off  
- Time starts on selecting 'Story' or 'Replay Story'  
- Time ends when the black screen with stars finishes scrolling across after the end level cutscene  

---

**Restrictions**

- Emulators are banned  
- Use of modified game files is not allowed
- Home Menu Abuse (on Wii), or abusing spamming the home menu button to moon jump and gain extra height, is banned.  
- USB Loading is NOT allowed  

---

**Video Rules**

- All runs require video proof with audio.  
- Any runs done with LRT must show the timer for the full run, and any pauses of the timer will be timed back into the run during verification  
- Taking a break during the run is not allowed.  

---

**Solo Rules**

- One player (can play with 2 controllers)
